Ortho-K Myopia Lenses in Pine Beach

Book AppointmentCall: (732) 978-9306

If you’re looking for a way to see clearly without wearing vision correction during the day, ortho-k treatment might be exactly what you’ve been looking for. These specially designed lenses are worn overnight and reshape your eyes while you sleep, so you can wake up with clear vision and go about your day. It’s a simple, non-surgical option that works for both kids and adults.

What Is Orthokeratology?

Orthokeratology, often called ortho-k, uses custom-fit contact lenses that you wear while you sleep. As you rest, the lenses gently reshape the front surface of your eyes. By morning, you can remove them and see clearly throughout the day—no glasses or daytime contacts needed. The effect is temporary, making it a safe and flexible option for many patients.

Book AppointmentCall: (732) 978-9306

How Ortho-K Improves Your Vision

Ortho-k lenses carefully adjust how light enters your eyes by reshaping the cornea overnight. This allows light to focus properly during the day, giving you clear vision without the need for lenses while you’re awake. As long as the lenses are worn consistently at night, the results continue day after day.

Call: (732) 978-9306

Why Patients Love Ortho-K

Ortho-k lenses offer a level of flexibility that traditional options don’t:

  • Clear vision during the day without glasses or contact lenses
  • Great for sports, active lifestyles, and busy routines
  • A non-surgical alternative to LASIK
  • Ideal for kids as part of a myopia management plan
Book Appointment

Getting Started with Ortho-K Treatment

We’ll start with a detailed eye exam and measurements to determine if ortho-k is right for you. From there, we’ll design custom lenses and show you exactly how to use and care for them.

It may take a few days for your vision to adjust fully, but we’ll guide you through the process and check in along the way to make sure everything is working as it should.

Schedule an Ortho-K Consultation

If you’re curious about ortho-k, the best next step is a conversation. We’ll take the time to evaluate your eyes, answer your questions, and help you decide if it’s a good fit. Give us a call to schedule a visit with our Pine Beach eye clinic.

Explore Our Range

  • Same-Day Contacts »

    Whether you can leave a fitting already wearing new lenses depends on a few things: your prescription, the type of lens that suits your eyes, and whether that exact lens is available to try.

  • Scleral Lenses »

    If you’ve had trouble wearing contacts in the past, scleral lenses may be a better option. These lenses are designed for sensitive eyes or more complex vision needs.

  • Toric Contacts »

    If you have astigmatism, you may have heard that contacts won’t work for you, or tried a pair years ago that never seemed quite clear.

  • Gas Permeable Contacts »

    Rigid gas permeable lenses, often called RGP or GP lenses, are firm contact lenses made from a material that lets oxygen pass through to your eye.

  • Multifocal Contacts »

    If you’ve started holding your phone or a menu at arm’s length to read it, you’re far from alone.
